note: All repos verified via GitHub API + raw README on 2026-10-31. All MIT, all branch main, none archived.

pipelines.name: claude-motion-design
bootstrap: py -3.12 -m pip install playwright imageio-ffmpeg numpy pillow
pipelines.notes: Motion-design skill: every frame computed from seek(t), screenshotted, blended for subframe blur. NO TTS (music/SFX only). Skill folder: skill/motion-design; demo: examples/howseen-launch (24s).

pipelines.name: code-video-showcase
pipelines.notes: 30-90s beat-synced style showcase; 11 style recipes; no bundled fonts; no demo video. Bash helpers qa-check.sh / concat-and-encode.sh need Git Bash. Per-project npm i playwright.

pipelines.name: explainer-video
pipelines.offline: no (Edge TTS online) - use --audio for offline
pipelines.notes: Only pipeline whose voice needs network (Microsoft Edge TTS endpoint, no key). Escape hatch: --audio file.mp3; cached MP3s at ~/.cache/explainer-video/voice. GSAP from jsdelivr - vendor locally for offline.

pipelines.name: paper-reel
pipelines.language: Node>=18 + Playwright + ffmpeg + whisper.cpp + Kokoro ONNX
pipelines.notes: 9:16 papercut faceless reels; word-timed from Kokoro TTS + whisper.cpp. README says macOS + brew; bin/reel is a bash CLI. Needs WSL or a hand-written Windows shim.

pipelines.name: khan-explainer
bootstrap: cd scripts && npx playwright install chromium
pipelines.notes: Khan-style pen-drawing explainer; voice drives the clock. Default voice is macOS say; Windows only escape is KHAN_TTS=kokoro (inferred, untested) - prefer macOS/WSL or skip on Windows.

pipelines.name: paper-motion-video
pipelines.notes: Paper -> ~2min narrated explainer with rebuilt charts, synced subs, score; 16:9 + 4:5 cuts. Best Windows support (pmv.cmd). First run downloads venv+Kokoro+fonts (5-10 min). Very new repo (1 star) - treat as unproven.

pipelines.name: ffmpeg-skill
pipelines.notes: 42-tool local editor: probe/fit/export/render/check/look. No cloud, no keys, no model downloads. Needs full FFmpeg 5.0+ (libass/drawtext/zscale/loudnorm/xfade/scdet/vidstab). 'npx ffmpeg-skill doctor' is the pack-wide FFmpeg smoke test.
